description:
What is This Part?
This Tie-Down Kit secures the battery to the engine bay/battery compartment.
Comes with everything you need to successfully secure the battery to the engine compartment.
Secures the Battery Longs ways (Clamp bracket runs long ways across the top of the battery)
Maximum Battery Length – 12 1/2″
Maximum Battery Height – 12” *
*(max height created by combining long & short tie-down hooks)
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Large Length Battery Tie-Down Bar
Qty 2 – Long Threaded Tie-Down Hook Rods
Qty 2 – L Brackets
Qty 2 – Nuts & Washers for Tie-Down Hook Rods
Qty 2 – Flange Bolts and Flange Nuts for L Bracket Installation (washer shown in picture has been replaced by Flange Bolts & Nuts)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
